title: 119 신고: 무슨 일이에요? 어디예요?
objective: You can call 119 to say what happened and where you are, and say what seems wrong with -는/-ㄴ/-ㄹ 것 같아요.
summary: A short 119 call: say what happened, where you are, and what you think is wrong.
setting: A phone call to 119. The caller is in front of Exit 2 of Seoul Station, where an elderly man has collapsed.

task.title: Report an emergency
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to complete, answer, or order the Korean.

words.meaning: to collapse, to fall down suddenly
to get hurt, to be injured
words.exampleMeaning: I fell on the stairs and hurt my ankle.
The patient has a high fever right now.

words.meaning: to move (the body or a person)
words.exampleMeaning: My leg hurts so much I can't move.

dialogue.korean: 할아버지 한 분이 길에서 쓰러졌어요. 숨을 잘 못 쉬는 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: An elderly man collapsed on the street. It seems he can't breathe well.

dialogue.korean: 주소는 잘 모르겠어요. 서울역 2번 출구 앞이에요.
dialogue.meaning: I don't know the address. I'm in front of Exit 2 of Seoul Station.
Okay. Is the patient responding when you talk to him?

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 대답을 안 해요. 머리에서 피가 나요. 넘어질 때 다친 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: No, he doesn't answer. His head is bleeding. I think he got hurt when he fell.

dialogue.korean: 환자를 움직이지 마세요. 그리고 전화를 끊지 마세요.
dialogue.meaning: Don't move the patient. And don't hang up.

exercises: Complete with 것 같아요, using the verb in brackets: ① 저 사람이 못 일어나요. 다리를 ____. (다치다) ② 창문에서 연기가 많이 나와요. 2층에서 불이 ____. (나다) ③ 길이 많이 막혀요. 구급차가 좀 늦게 ____. (오다)
Answer the 119 operator in Korean, using the hint: ① 119: 환자가 피가 나요? (Yes, from the arm. 팔) ② 119: 환자가 움직여요? (No.)
Read the dialogue. The operator tells the caller not to do two things. What are they? Answer in English.
Put the steps of a 119 call in order: (가) 주소나 위치를 말해요. (나) 무슨 일이 있는지 말해요. (다) 119에 전화해요. (라) 전화를 끊지 않고 구급차를 기다려요.
answers: ① 다친 것 같아요 ② 난 것 같아요 ③ 올 것 같아요
① 네, 팔에서 피가 나요. ② 아니요, 안 움직여요. (못 움직여요.)
Don't move the patient, and don't hang up the phone.
